name: base64-pdf-clipboard-cli
description: CLI + GUI para ler Base64 do clipboard, validar PDF e salvar em Downloads

scripts.build:mac: electron-builder --mac --dir && xattr -cr dist/mac*/*.app 2>/dev/null && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/mac*/*.app 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.install:mac: npm run build:mac && APP_PATH=$(ls -d dist/mac*/'Base64 PDF Converter.app' | head -n 1) && cp -R "$APP_PATH" "/Applications/Base64 PDF Converter.app" && xattr -cr "/Applications/Base64 PDF Converter.app" && echo '✅ Instalado em /Applications'
